# Gloom Bean Unity

Unity platformer implementation with a reusable Wario Land-inspired mechanical foundation and the original Gloom Bean Host Cycle campaign.

This repository is public by explicit owner direction. Existing local implementation history remains authoritative until the full verified history is attached and pushed.
